title: Start the interview
caption: Hands-on 1a: clarify your intent with the AI, then start the grill and keep the chat open.

steps.first: Step “Clarify the intent”: put your goal in the box, paste the prompt into a new chat.
steps.second: Answer each round like “1.2 2.3” (question.option), then confirm the three categories it marks ★.
steps.third: Copy its result back into the Workflow.
steps.fourth: Step “Grill me and write the spec”: paste the prompt into a new chat and answer; leave it open for the next Episode.

done: Your intent sits in the Workflow, and the grill has asked its first questions.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: Today’s Workflow, “Turn a source into a quiz”, is already picked. Each step has its prompt to copy, for an AI chat or a coding agent; paste each result back into its box.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Requirements: Clarify the intent, then Grill: Grill me and write the spec

talking-points.description: Start the grill now and stop after about twenty minutes, mid-interview: the requirements Episode explains what the participants are doing, and they finish it right after. ChatGPT works; Gemini or Claude are better at the later HTML page.
